commitments.detail: Submit a voluntary self-disclosure report to OFAC within 7 days.
Implement enhanced sanctions screening controls for all future transactions with the reseller.
Conduct a thorough review of the reseller’s compliance with U.S. sanctions laws and regulations.
Hold the blocked funds until further notice and do not release them without prior approval from legal counsel.
Develop a wind-down plan for the reseller relationship over the next 30 days.
